source.title: New directions and open problems in iteration theory

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 3875903. Local run metadata and indexed zbMATH metadata identify the exact work as György Targonski, 'New directions and open problems in iteration theory' (1984), Zbl 0549.39003, listed as Bericht Nr. 229 in the Graz reports series. Metadata was used only to identify the exact source and recovery queries, not as extraction evidence.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell access to zbmath.org; metadata_only for zbMATH author/listing pages and the Uni Graz report index; no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML body was available through the direct zbMATH URL, the documented zbMATH API entry point exposed only the terms gate through the page reader, and the report index listed only the title rather than the report text.

Ran exact-work recovery using the zbMATH identifier 3875903, Zbl identifier 0549.39003, exact title, author, year, and report-series identifier 'Grazer Math. Ber. 229'. Search recovered only bibliographic citations, author bibliography entries, a report-series table of contents, or later papers that cite the 1984 report. Candidates such as Springer survey/reference pages, ScienceDirect reference pages, Cambridge reference pages, the Uni Graz report index, and the György Targonski bibliography page were rejected because they do not contain the 1984 report's technical problem statements. Search snippets and citation metadata were rejected as extraction sources under the source adequacy gate.

No document map was produced because no readable primary source artifact was available. zbMATH and the recovered pages were treated as resolvers or bibliographic metadata, not as the technical source text.

No candidates were extracted, rewritten, deduplicated, or accepted because the chosen source could not be resolved to readable full text containing the open-problem statements. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting from resolver metadata, bibliographic entries, references, abstracts, or search snippets.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3875903.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
